title: Later Mughals Jahandar Shah
definition: Jahandar Shah (1712–1713) was the second ruler of the Later Mughal period, whose short reign marked the beginning of the 'Kingmaker' era and the institutionalization of administrative decay.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC tests the transition from the centralized Mughal state to the era of court factions, the rise of the Sayyid Brothers, and the shift in fiscal policies like Ijarah.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Later Mughals Jahandar Shah.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
